thought.title: Baseline-aligned masked softmax kernel with merge_n batching
thought.description: Aligned AscendC kernel with CANNBench baseline reference. Single MSRPBKernel with CopyTiling, TQue-based per-row processing. Vectorized Cast(qk+bias→fp32), Add, Adds, Exp, Muls operations. Scalar mask comparison and sum (unavoidable due to AscendC Select API requiring uint8 selMask incompatible with CompareScalar float output). Merge_n batching with rowFactor up to 8 to amortize TQue overhead. PipeBarrier after vector ops before scalar reads for correctness.
thought.reason: Initial approach with vectorized sub-tensor views (workF32[rowOff]) and merge_n-single_row split failed due to AscendC sub-tensor unreliability and DataCopy alignment issues. Baseline-aligned approach proved correct. Scalar mask unavoidable - CompareScalar produces float bit patterns incompatible with Select's uint8 selMask requirement.
thought.target_bottleneck: scalar mask+sum per-row, TQue per-row overhead
